text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- The Full victory of socialist party in France forces Chirac into a difficult cohabitation.
- Real Madrid (soccer club) almost champion.
EL MUNDO
- Left wing wins in France, and Jospin promises to 'redirect the construction of Europe'.
- Real Madrid, one point from title in league championship
DIARIO 16
- Left sweeping victory.
ABC
- Chirac, his mistakes make him cohabit with the left
CINCO DIAS
- Strong euro 'au revoir'.
- Labour Minister wants to limit measures fostering new jobs in the regional governments.
- (CiU's leader) Pujol and (Prime Minister) Aznar refuse to be together at the inauguration of the new railway Euromed between Barcelona and Alicante.
EXPANSION
- Victory of the left in France
- Spanish bank BCH to sell CEPSA shares in bourse, stopping Endesa (which hoped to buy them).
- Financier Herberto Gut dies in a car accident.
- Chilean Luksic will be strategical partner of Telefonica
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Socialist triumph increases markets uncertainty.
- Jurgen Donges, Bonn's economic advisor says "it makes more sense to delay EMU than doing tricks".
- Industry Minister to offer Gas Natural money to share its distributive network.
- Private investors and investment trusts have a third in the share market.
-- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
